INSERT INTO whatsapp.mesaje (
  contact_id,
  directie,
  tip,
  mesaj,
  message_id,
  necesita_raspuns,
  alerta_trimisa
)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, false, false)
ON CONFLICT (message_id)
DO NOTHING
RETURNING *;

SELECT
  m.id,
  m.contact_id AS client_id,
  m.directie,
  m.tip,
  m.mesaj,
  NULL::text AS media_url,
  m.message_id,
  m.created_at
FROM (
  SELECT *
  FROM whatsapp.mesaje
  WHERE contact_id = $1
  ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
  LIMIT 30
) m
ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.id ASC;

VALUES ($1, 'outgoing', $2, $3, $4, false, false)

INSERT INTO whatsapp.contacte (telefon, nume)
SELECT
  $1,
  CASE
    WHEN $3 = 'incoming'
     AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE($2, ''))) NOT IN (
       'mozy service electronice',
       'você'
     )
    THEN NULLIF(TRIM($2), '')
    ELSE NULL
  END
WHERE NULLIF(TRIM($1), '') IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (telefon)
DO UPDATE SET
  nume = COALESCE(whatsapp.contacte.nume, EXCLUDED.nume),
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RETURNING *;

WITH saved_appointment AS (
  INSERT INTO whatsapp.programari (
    contact_id,
    conversation_message_id,
    data_programare,
    ora_programare,
    adresa,
    defect_reclamat,
    marca,
    model,
    diagonala,
    observatii,
    status,
    incredere,
    rezultat_ai
  )
  SELECT
    $1::bigint,
    $2::bigint,
    $3::date,
    $4::time,
    NULLIF($5::text, ''),
    NULLIF($6::text, ''),
    NULLIF($7::text, ''),
    NULLIF($8::text, ''),
    NULLIF($9::text, ''),
    NULLIF($10::text, ''),
    $11::text,
    $12::numeric,
    $13::jsonb
  WHERE $11::text <> 'nespecificat'
  ON CONFLICT (conversation_message_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    data_programare = EXCLUDED.data_programare,
    ora_programare = EXCLUDED.ora_programare,
    adresa = EXCLUDED.adresa,
    defect_reclamat = EXCLUDED.defect_reclamat,
    marca = EXCLUDED.marca,
    model = EXCLUDED.model,
    diagonala = EXCLUDED.diagonala,
    observatii = EXCLUDED.observatii,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    incredere = EXCLUDED.incredere,
    rezultat_ai = EXCLUDED.rezultat_ai,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  RETURNING id
)
UPDATE whatsapp.mesaje
SET
  necesita_raspuns = $14::boolean,
  alerta_trimisa = false
WHERE id = $2::bigint
RETURNING id, contact_id, necesita_raspuns, alerta_trimisa;
